name: Barksdale AFB
description: Home of Air Force Global Strike Command and the 2nd Bomb Wing. Barksdale AFB operates B-52H Stratofortress bombers and supports global strike missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Shreveport (West) Gate — Main
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with West Gate Visitor Center (0600-2200 daily). After-hours passes at gate.

gates.name: West Gate Visitor Center
gates.address: Wilbur Wright Dr, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

gates.name: Industrial (East) Gate
gates.notes: Commercial and limited passenger access. East VCC Mon-Fri 0600-1745.

resources.name: Touch-n-Go Flight Kitchen / DFAC
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting B-52 operations and base personnel with full meal service including midnight meals.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830, Midnight 2230-0030; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch/Dinner 1030-1830, Midnight 2230-0000

resources.name: Barksdale Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, food court, and shoppette.
resources.address: 455 Curtiss Rd, Bldg 4711, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

resources.name: Barksdale Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: SrA Bell Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with weights, cardio, group exercise, and 24/7 CAC access. Iron Airman Gym also available.
resources.hours: 24/7 for registered CAC holders; staffed hours Mon-Sun 0530-2000

resources.name: Barksdale Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including DVQ and TLF. 24/7 front desk for arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100
resources.address: 555 Davis Avenue West, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: 801 Kenney Ave, Suite 1400, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

resources.name: 2nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, RV storage, archery, shotgun sports, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Fox Run Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and snack bar.

resources.name: Bomber Alley Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling alley with snack bar and league play.

resources.name: 2nd Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

events.title: Physical Training Course (10 weeks)
events.description: 10-week PT course Mon/Wed/Fri 0630-0730; barksdalelife.com.

events.title: Iron Warrior Program
events.description: Location: SrA Bell Fitness Center Dates: September 14 through November 20; Training will only take place on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 0630 until 0730 during the course dates. All active-duty, civilians, retirees and dependents are welcome to attend. Improve your overall fitness, build strength and endurance over the 10 week physical training course! For questions about the program, or to sign up call 318-456-4135.

events.title: Wood Shop Certification Class
events.description: Date: October 3 and 10 at 10am Price: $95 per person, $170 per two people (spouse or relative); price includes all instruction and supplies Learn how to build your own nightstand from the pros in the Wood Shop! To sign up call the Wood Shop at 318-456-3409 . Sign ups must be at least 72 hours before the class.

events.title: Fall Break Bowling Special
events.description: Price: $1.75 per person/game; $3 shoe rentals per person Have some fun during fall break over at the Bomber Alley Bowling Center! Kids ages 18 and under are able to enjoy the special. For further questions, call 318-456-4133.

events.title: Air Force Teen Council
events.description: Price: FREE and lunch will be provided for the teens who participate. Who can Participate: ALL military teens are welcome to participate Location: Youth Center This is an initiative to provide a voice for Air Force teens and a connection to installation leaders to provide a platform for the needs and passions of teens. Registration can be done through the CYPBMS portal. If you need the initial registration link, call the Youth Center at 318-456-3448.

events.title: Month of the Military Family Special
events.description: Location: Bomber Alley Bowling Center Times: Every Tuesday in October from 11am until 8pm Price: $1.50 per person/game; $3 shoe rentals per person Celebrate Month of the Military Family by going to the Bomber Alley Bowling Center! Kids can also eat for FREE from 5pm until closing. For further questions about the special, call 318-456-4133.

events.title: Krafty Kids
events.description: Price: $5 per person; Includes all supplies and instruction Create a Halloween candy pot with Arts and Crafts! To sign up call Arts and Crafts at 318-456-3140. Sign-ups must be done at least 72 hours before the class.

events.title: Wood Shop Certification Class
events.description: Date: October 3 and 10 at 10am Price: $95 per person, $170 per two people (spouse or relative); price includes all instruction and supplies Learn how to build your own nightstand from the pros in the Wood Shop! To sign up call the Wood Shop at 318-456-3409 . Sign ups must be at least 72 hours before the class.

events.title: Lake Charles Fishing Trip
events.description: Price: $675 per person plus tip money for fishing guide. Price is ALL INCLUSIVE, it includes transportation, food/lodging, boat fees, equipment, and take home fish (BYO cooler). Payment plans are available, and the last payment will be due on September 14. Participants are asked to meet at the Multiplex at 12pm the day of departure. Limited spots are available so call Outdoor Rec at 318-456-3426 to reserve your spot

events.title: Colorama
events.description: Location: Bomber Alley Bowling Center Price: $20 per person; Shoe rentals are $3 per person There’s no need to sign up, just pay the $20 and let the games begin! For questions call the bowling center at 318-456-4133. Must be 18 years old or older to participate.

events.title: Corks and Crafts
events.description: Price: $25 per person; includes instruction and supplies Bring your old coffee mug, that's fire safe, and turn it into a candle! The class is BYOB. Call Arts and Crafts at 318-456-3140 to sign up today. Sign-ups must be done at least 72 hours before the class.

events.title: Month of the Military Family Special
events.description: Location: Bomber Alley Bowling Center Times: Every Tuesday in October from 11am until 8pm Price: $1.50 per person/game; $3 shoe rentals per person Celebrate Month of the Military Family by going to the Bomber Alley Bowling Center! Kids can also eat for FREE from 5pm until closing. For further questions about the special, call 318-456-4133.

events.title: SplatterOps Thursdays
events.description: Price: $25 per person; Includes gear and one 500 round bag of paintballs Location: Paintball Field; near Clear Lake Additional paintball bags will be sold for $11 per bag. Grab your crew and have some fun out at the paintball field! RSVPs are required. For questions call Outdoor Rec at 318-456-3426.

events.title: Trivia Night
events.description: Location: Hangar 2 Join Hangar 2 for Trivia Night — where the questions are tough, the laughs are plenty, and the competition is fierce! Bring your friends, test your knowledge, and see if you can claim the top spot. For questions about Trivia Night, call 318-456-2738.

events.title: Sip and Paint
events.description: Price: $15 per person; Includes all supplies and instruction This unique experience invites you and your partner - whether romantic duo or close friends - to sit across from each other and create portraits of one another! No experience necessary! This class is BYOB. Call Arts and Crafts at 318-456-3140 to sign up today. Sign-ups must take place at least 72 hours before the class.

events.title: Auto Hobby Late Night
events.description: Attention shift workers and night owls! Auto Hobby is having another Late Night! Call 318-456-4695 for further questions about the program, or email autohobby.barksdale@gmail.com.

events.title: Hot Springs Day Trip
events.description: Registration Deadline: October 15 Price: $8 per person; Price includes transportation only. All other expenses are the responsibility of the participant. Spend a day with Outdoor Rec exploring the historical bathhouses of Hot Springs! Participants will meet at the FSS Multiplex before departing for Hot Springs at 7am. Spots are limited so call ODR at 318-456-3426 to register today!

events.title: Auto Brake Class
events.description: Learn how to change your own brakes from the pros at Auto Hobby! People ages 16 and older are welcome to join the class. To sign up call Auto Hobby at 318-456-4695. Sign-ups must take place at least 72 hours before the class.

events.title: BoOoksdale
events.description: Location: Mission Support Group building parking lot Price: FREE for all ages! This is a family-friendly Halloween event, so leave the super-scary stuff at home! Get ready to TRUNK or TREAT your way into the spooky season at BoOoksdale! Our Trunk or Treat & Vendor Market! Think you have what it takes to create the ULTIMATE Halloween trunk?! Contact Amanda Dixon at amanda.dixon.15@us.af.mil to sign up yours today! Prizes will be awarded for People’s Choice, Most Creative, and Best Overall Trunk. BONUS: No need to worry about stocking up on treats! The FSS will provide ALL the candy for you to h

events.title: Adult Scary Movie Night
events.description: Double Feature: A Quiet Place and A Quiet Place 2 Times: The first movie will start at 6:30pm, the second movie will start at 8:15pm RSVPs are required! Movie goers must RSVP by October 29. The movie will be FREE to watch, and concessions and pizza slices will be available for purchase. Call Outdoor Rec at 318-456-3426 to reserve your spot today!

events.title: Halloween Glow Bowl Bash
events.description: Price: $8 per person; Shoe rentals are included in price. Celebrate Halloween before trick-or-treating at the Bomber Alley Bowling Center! Pay $8 and enjoy all the bowling you want for 2 hours. There will also be door prizes! For further questions about the bash, call 318-456-4133.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Barksdale Inn (318-456-3091) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 2 FSS, M&FRC, and official Barksdale sites for in-processing and Global Strike Command support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
